card.name: Verbs of adding or giving in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The verb after "to" in preparation-table headings, such as "Volume to Add", "to withdraw" or "to be added". It also fires on "Admin" + "ister" in administration steps.

modes.label: Verb after "volume to"
modes.description: Action verb ending a table column heading about how much diluent or solution to add, use or withdraw.
modes.example: Table 1 for volume of diluent to<< use>>.

modes.label: Administer heading
modes.description: The ending of "Administer" at the start of an administration instruction or in a volume heading.
